Hi Lena — thanks for the quick turn.

This is enough to start a draft vendor record in our system. A couple of asks to make the master record production-ready and ensure correct PO routing:

1) Can you confirm the legal entity used for contracting (is it the full 'Fathom Blue Technologies, Inc.' or a holding name)? We need the exact name that will appear on contracts and W-9.
2) Beneficial owner info: per our compliance rules we collect a short BO summary (name, country, ownership %) for anyone >25% ownership — a one-paragraph reply is fine.
3) Please confirm VAT/foreign tax registration only if applicable (I assume not, but want to be sure).
4) PO routing: we map POs to the AP contact. If you prefer a different PO-to-email (for automated ingestion) tell us the exact address.
5) Preferred invoice format: PDF with PO number in the filename is ideal. Sample invoice helps map taxes and line items — could you attach one?

If you prefer, we can send a vendor portal invite for secure upload of bank details; otherwise we can accept the stubbed bank details you sent and our AP team will follow up with a secure link for the full banking form.

I'll loop in Jordan (cc) on tax/treaty questions and Kim for ERP mapping to the correct GL/PO lane. Once we have the BO note and confirm contractual name we can finish the master and confirm the first PO routing.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
